new_entities.name: Vehicle components which could change shape or position

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.
obligations.ears: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied
obligations.ears: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude, and shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.

derived.text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude.
The vehicle shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components
obligations.ears: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude
obligations.ears: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test
obligations.ears: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
obligations.ears: The manufacturer shall show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position
obligations.exception: other than active devices to protect pedestrians
obligations.ears: When vehicle components could change shape or position and have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1
obligations.ears: When tested as a DPPS, the vehicle shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1.
